turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS metric, so I can't give a ratio; the closest metrics are booking value (EUR) and ad spend (EUR), which for 1-30 September 2026 were EUR 128,900 of booking value and EUR 6,270 of ad spend. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
